Emei and Hongya (3.88 to 4.65) at overlapping head length (HL 11.46, 13.13 and 12.45 against 11.74 to 14.15); ED/HL is about 0.19 to 0.20 for those three and about 0.30 to 0.36 for the CIB paratypes (ratios computed by the desk, not printed).
